summary: Iteration 7 — Validated four new scaffolds (Sentry / RAG / Client-Auth / Resend) plus the client portal end-to-end. 8/8 pytest specs pass; all UI flows pass on the public preview URL (https://mpls-automation-hub.preview.emergentagent.com). Tenant isolation, JWT aud-scoping, magic-link verify, dashboard render, admin tab, RAG ingest+query+isolation, and regression on Operations / Health / Compliance / Design Partners / Competitive Edge tabs all green.
critical_code_review_comments: Code review · server.py · DELETE /api/rag/tenant/{tenant_id}/{doc_id} always returns ok:true even when the doc didn't exist in-memory (store.delete returns False but the response still says ok:true via the mongo delete). Consider returning 404 when ok is False for stricter API contract — not blocking.

Code review · server.py is 4214 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. The new RAG/client-auth/scaffold endpoints would benefit from extraction into routers/rag.py and routers/client_auth.py during the next refactor pass. Not blocking for this iteration.

Code review · /api/rag/query is unauthenticated by design (used by future agent runtime), but it also has no rate-limit. A misbehaving client can fan out queries cheaply against the in-memory store. Consider adding _rate_limited(_client_key(request, 'rag-query'), 60, 60) before the GA cut.

Code review · ClientLogin.jsx and ClientDashboard.jsx are clean, but the magic-link anchor in preview mode uses href + click → full reload. That works, but a router navigate to /client/verify?token=... would feel snappier; minor UX nit.
test_credentials: admin@jadeos.ai / JadeOS!2026 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Client portal uses any email — magic link minted in preview mode (no Resend wired).
seed_data_creation: Created throwaway client_user TEST_design+<uuid>@partner.com and TEST_ prefixed RAG docs under TEST_acme-freight tenant. The full-flow test deletes its own RAG doc; the per-tenant store is in-memory and resets on backend restart anyway.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin login is at /login (not /admin/login). Submit button label is 'OPEN THE VAULT' — use get_by_role or text match. Admin route is /admin. Client portal: /client/login → form (data-testid=client-login-card, client-email, client-company, client-magic-btn) → magic result (client-magic-result, client-magic-link anchor) → /client/verify?token=... auto-redirects to /client/dashboard (data-testid=client-dashboard). Integrations tab data-testid=admin-tab-integrations; panel renders integrations-panel with scaffold-{sentry,rag,client-auth,resend} cards plus rag-testbench (rag-tenant, rag-title, rag-content, rag-ingest-btn, rag-query, rag-query-btn, rag-result). All four scaffolds correctly read 'AWAITING KEY' in preview — this is intentional (empty SENTRY_DSN, no VECTOR_STORE_PROVIDER, no RESEND_API_KEY). Treat WIRED · LIVE as activated state only when keys are dropped.
